title: How a Ponzi scheme keeps running (Madoff)

hook.a: Madoff's statements showed about sixty-five billion dollars. Most never existed.
hook.b: Ponzi schemes don't die when returns stop. They die when deposits do.

numbers.formula: 'About sixty-five billion' = $64.8B rounded. Invented = $64.8B - $17.5B = $47.3B (73.0%). Multiple = $64.8B / $17.5B = 3.70x. Years to reach the multiple at rate g = ln(3.70) / ln(1+g): 13.7 yrs at 10%, 19.3 yrs at 7% (illustration; ignores deposit/withdrawal timing).

analysis.title: $64.8B on paper vs $17.5B real: what return does that imply?
analysis.finding: 73% of the $64.8B on Madoff's statements was invented. Turning $17.5B into $64.8B at a steady rate would take about 14 years at 10% a year, or ~19 years at 7%.
